# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148. It adds variable and color font support, animated WebP encoding, new drawing and stream APIs, broader native assets, and substantial correctness fixes. This is a breaking release: review the migration notes before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy SKPaint text, font and filtering APIs are compile errors** — Previously obsolete SKPaint text/font members and paint-only drawing or shaping overloads are now errors. Move text state to `SKFont`, pass `SKTextAlign` explicitly, and replace `SKFilterQuality` use with `SKSamplingOptions` overloads. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114))
- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are removed from the reference surface** — Legacy backend render-target constructors and run-buffer span methods are now compile errors; `SKPaintHinting` and `SKFilterQuality` are absent from the reference assembly. Use constructors without `sampleCount`, the `Glyphs` or `Positions` properties, `SKFontHinting`, and `SKSamplingOptions`. ([#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **A default SKFont now uses SKTypeface.Empty** — `new SKFont()` and assigning a null typeface now produce an empty typeface, so text measures to zero and draws nothing. Construct with `SKTypeface.Default` or another explicit typeface, and use `Typeface.IsEmpty` to detect an unset font. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKPaint and missing-family typeface null semantics change** — `new SKPaint().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Default`, and `SKTypeface.FromFamilyName` returns the default rather than null for a missing Android family. Stop using those null checks; use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily` when a strict no-match result is required. ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730))
- **SKStream.Move(long) is obsolete and checks its range** — `SKStream.Move(long)` now throws `OverflowException` instead of truncating offsets outside the 32-bit native range. Validate the offset and call `Move(int)`. ([#3714](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3714))
- **Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1** — `GRContext.CreateVulkan` terminates the process for Vulkan 1.0 rather than returning null. Create the instance with Vulkan 1.1 or later and set `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` accordingly; Vulkan 1.0-only devices must use raster or another backend.
- **GRVkBackendContextNative removes legacy fields** — The native Vulkan context drops `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`. Delete those assignments, replace the extension and feature fields with `fVkExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures` or `fDeviceFeatures2`, and manage instance/device ownership separately.
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion information changes type and layout** — `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo`, whose layout adds `Components`; the old-cased compatibility type no longer provides value equality. Update declarations and layout-dependent interop, populate `Components`, and replace equality operators with explicit field comparisons. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — The protected setter for `IgnorePublicDispose` is removed. Custom subclasses must remove assignments and revise their disposal implementation so it no longer mutates this base property. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Tizen 32-bit native assets are removed** — The Tizen arm and x86 packages are no longer produced after the Skia m147 update. Move Tizen deployments to the new `tizen-arm64` or `tizen-x64` runtime identifiers. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **WebAssembly native assets require .NET 8 or later** — Native assets for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions are removed, and net6.0 or net7.0 WebAssembly projects now fail at build time. Upgrade WebAssembly applications to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Assembly identity moves to v4** — The SkiaSharp assembly version changes from 3.119.0.0 to 4.148.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks that pin the v3 assembly identity.

## Engine

- **Skia advances through m132 and m147 to m148** — The engine update brings HDR and wide-gamut improvements, codec and filter corrections, CICP color spaces, the RF16 and other HDR color types, plus upstream raster-pipeline, runtime-effect and malformed-region fixes. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Bundled image and font libraries refreshed** — Updates libpng to 1.6.58, zlib to 1.3.2.1-motley, FreeType to 2.14.3, and libjpeg-turbo to 3.1.4.1. ([#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp expose variation axes, design positions, named instances and palette selection, with `HBColor` and conversion helpers representing HarfBuzz palette colors correctly. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742), [#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000))
- **SKPathBuilder becomes the path mutation API** — The new builder wraps Skia's immutable-path model, while fill-path and path-measure operations gain builder overloads. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Surface draws accept SKSamplingOptions** — New `SKSurface.Draw` and `SKCanvas.DrawSurface` overloads let callers control filtering and mipmapping when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding** — `SKWebpEncoder` writes single-frame or animated WebP content from frame sequences with per-frame durations. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771))
- **Streams expose backing SKData** — `SKStream.GetData()` returns ref-counted backing data when the stream can provide it cheaply, avoiding a copy for memory-backed streams. ([#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **Missing document, GPU and mask-filter wrappers added** — Adds XPS document creation, per-image and per-surface GPU flushes, and shader-backed mask filters. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates** — `SKPixmap` and `SKBitmap` pixel spans now use `RowBytes`, and typed coordinate access uses the correct row axis for non-square images and subsets. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **Typeface and variable-font handling corrected** — Default typeface resolution no longer crashes on Android API 36, undersized variation spans report correctly, and `SKTypeface.ContainsGlyphs` no longer recurses to a stack overflow. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **SKPath finalization no longer dereferences a collected builder** — Disposal skips pending-builder flushing once finalization begins, preventing a crash when `SKPathBuilder` is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android SKGLView survives tab and page navigation** — A reattached GL view starts with its existing dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **WinUI projection loading restored for .NET 9** — The projection assembly is packaged under compatible .NET 9 and .NET 10 runtime folders so .NET 9 applications can load it at startup. ([#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))
- **NanoServer font initialization no longer crashes** — Windows NanoServer builds use an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an access violation on first SkiaSharp use. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Native compatibility checks wait for first interop use** — The compatibility gate moves from assembly initialization to `SkiaApi`, allowing applications to configure native-library resolution before the first P/Invoke while retaining version diagnostics. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Adds `linux-bionic` x64 and arm64 packages and native libraries for the `tizen-x64` and `tizen-arm64` runtime identifiers. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple library target frameworks realigned** — Library packages use the base 26.0 Apple target-platform versions, avoiding an unnecessary Xcode 26.2 requirement for consumers. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WebAssembly support starts at .NET 8** — Packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and issue a clear build error for unsupported net6.0 and net7.0 applications. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Linux compatibility baselines are explicit** — Official .NET cross-compilation images broaden the glibc baseline to 2.27 on arm64, x64 and x86 while preserving musl and Bionic packaging. ([#4062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4062))

## Security

- **libexpat receives security hardening** — The bundled XML parser advances to libexpat 2.8.1, including its upstream security-hardening changes. ([#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

Updates HarfBuzzSharp from 8.3.1.5 to 14.2.0 with improved OpenType shaping, CFF2 subsetting and font-table handling. It also adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, the `HBColor` value type, and Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets.
